Q: Thanks for taking the time to talk with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision at the intersection
in Houston, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just give my first name, if that's okay. It's the same as the policy holder's, so it's easy to confirm.
Q: That works. Can you walk me through what happened before the impact?
A: I was heading through the intersection on a green light. I had slowed a bit because traffic was backed up on the
cross street, but the signal was green when I entered.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the collision?
A: Not clearly. I saw something coming from my right, but it came out faster than I expected. I braked, but there
wasn't time to avoid it.
Q: Where did the impact hit your vehicle?
A: The driver's side door, right where I'm sitting. The airbags on that side went off and the car spun a little before
stopping.
Q: Did you get out of the vehicle right away?
A: I got out with some help. My left shoulder was hurting pretty badly, and I still have trouble lifting my arm above my
head. I went to an urgent care clinic that same afternoon.
Q: Have you received any treatment since then?
A: I've been going to physical therapy twice a week and I have a follow-up with an orthopedic doctor next month. The
pain wakes me up at night sometimes.
Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I was careful and followed the signal. I just want my shoulder taken care of and my car repaired.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
</page>

"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
